## Featured Projects

- [KodraX](https://pardeep-shyoran.me/projects/kodrax) ([Markdown](https://pardeep-shyoran.me/projects/kodrax.md)): A real-time collaborative code editor featuring room-based synchronization, secure JWT authentication, and Judge0 code execution. Stack: React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Socket.IO, Judge0 CE, Monaco Editor, JWT.
- [Rivo](https://pardeep-shyoran.me/projects/rivo) ([Markdown](https://pardeep-shyoran.me/projects/rivo.md)): A microservices-based music streaming platform featuring role-based access, AWS S3 track storage, and RabbitMQ event messaging. Stack: React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, AWS S3, ImageKit, JWT.
- [Lite-Insta](https://pardeep-shyoran.me/projects/lite-insta) ([Markdown](https://pardeep-shyoran.me/projects/lite-insta.md)): A MERN social platform featuring photo feeds, JWT session security, and Google Gemini AI caption generation. Stack: React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Google Gemini API, ImageKit, JWT, Redux Toolkit.

## Other Projects

- [MoodSwinger](https://pardeep-shyoran.me/projects/moodswinger) ([Markdown](https://pardeep-shyoran.me/projects/moodswinger.md)): An interactive music player utilizing client-side facial expression analysis via face-api.js to play mood-matching audio.
- [FOKUS](https://pardeep-shyoran.me/projects/fokus) ([Markdown](https://pardeep-shyoran.me/projects/fokus.md)): A responsive energy drink product showcase built with React, modular CSS, and dynamic JSON Server catalog feeds.
- [Windows 11 Web Clone](https://pardeep-shyoran.me/projects/windows-11) ([Markdown](https://pardeep-shyoran.me/projects/windows-11.md)): A functional browser-based Windows 11 desktop experience built purely with Vanilla JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
- [GitHub Profile Search](https://pardeep-shyoran.me/projects/github-profile-search) ([Markdown](https://pardeep-shyoran.me/projects/github-profile-search.md)): A responsive developer lookup tool interfacing with the GitHub REST API to render user metrics, repositories, and activity.
